newsitem.title: USA: Scotsman says acquisition to add to net.
newsitem.headline: Scotsman says acquisition to add to net.

text.p: Scotsman Industries Inc, which earlier reported lower first-quarter earnings after a charge, said Tuesday it expects its acquisition of Kysor Industrial Corp to add to earnings per share in the third and fourth quarters of this year.
Kysor's cycle will shift Scotsman's historical pattern of sales and earnings more to the second half of the year, said Scotsman's Chairman and Chief Executive Richard Osborne.

"We're very pleased with progress on the integration of Kysor where backlogs are at a record high and whose sales have traditionally been the strongest in the third and fourth quarters. We expect the acquisition to be accretive to Scotsman's EPS in the third and fourth quarters of this year and for the full year. We believe that, on a continuing basis, Kysor's cycle will shift Scotsman's historical pattern of sales and earnings more to the second half of the year," he said. Scotsman's revenues and earnings historically peaked in the second quarter, Osborne added.
Earlier Scotsman said first quarter earnings fell to $3.2 million, or $0.30 a share, including a $633,000 charge for early debt retirement from $3.3 million, or $0.36, last year.
